capabilities: Show selective note handouts to players.
extras: Requires purchase for full access; free trial available.
intentEvidence: Put the table on your players' phones: turn order, clocks and rolls, live from your notes.
problem: DMs need a way to present dynamic, up-to-date game information (like turn order and battle maps) to players' phones without manual updates or external software.
summary: A tool that projects a live, dynamic game table, including turn order, clocks, and battle maps, onto players' mobile devices from Obsidian notes.
